question: The simple interest on a certain sum for 4(1)/(2) years at 10% p.a. is 60% of the compound interest on a sum of Rs. 12,000 for 1 year at 10% p.a, interest compounded half yearly. The sum on which the simple interest is calculated is:
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Effective rate for CI at 10% p.a. compounded half-yearly for 1 year = 5% + 5% + (5×5)/100 = 10.25%

Total Compound Interest = 10.25% of 12000 = Rs. 1230

Given Simple Interest = 60% of CI = 0.60 × 1230 = Rs. 738

Using SI = (P × R × T) / 100 ⇒ P × 10 × 4.5 / 100 = 738

P × 0.45 = 738 ⇒ P = 1640

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 1640.**
